en.title: Strings with Limited Consecutive Vowels
en.description:
Count lowercase English strings of length n with at most k consecutive vowels. There are 5 vowels, aeiou, and 21 consonants. Output the count modulo 10⁹+7.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: One line: n k, with 1≤n≤2500 and 0≤k≤n.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 26; 412776; 451101. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Let dp[j] be the number of strings currently ending with exactly j consecutive vowels; appending a consonant resets it to zero, and appending a vowel increases j by 1, but j must not exceed k.
